headline: Tencent Hy4 preview combines 770B MoE capacity with sparse attention, IndexCache and native MTP
summary: Tencent released Hy4 preview under Apache-2.0 with a 770B-parameter MoE backbone, 49B active parameters per token, 1M context, Gated DeepSeek Sparse Attention, cross-layer IndexCache reuse, four-stream identity Hyper-Connections, and a native MTP layer intended for speculative decoding. Tencent lists API prices of CNY 6 per million input tokens, CNY 18 per million output tokens and cache-hit prices from CNY 0.3; its separate 31.8% throughput gain is a vendor claim without enough matched measurement detail for independent comparison.
